_doc: The Cash Shop catalog and the Fortune each cash slot adds (spec #34, ADR 0003). items[]: id (the MapleStory item id), kind (equip | pet | pet_upgrade), price (NX), sn (Etc.wz/Commodity.img serial number, tier A; omitted for survivor-only items), requires (item ids that must all be owned), requires_any (at least one of these must be owned), two_handed (weapon covers only: fills the weapon and shield slots), name/desc (survivor-only items; real items take them from String.wz). Real prices are the OnSale Commodity.img listings (tier A). The base pet already includes Item Pouch (1812001) and Meso Magnet (1812000): they are not sold. Pet upgrades 1812002-1812005 and VAC need an owned pet. Cash equipment entries (kind equip) are added by the catalog ticket (#117). An overall fills top and bottom; a two-handed weapon cover fills weapon and shield. The slot comes from id / 10000: 100 hat, 101 face, 102 eye, 103 earrings, 104 top, 105 overall, 106 bottom, 107 shoes, 108 gloves, 109 shield, 110 cape, 170 weapon cover.
_slot_fortune: Tier C: placeholder Fortune added by each filled cash slot, summing to 100 with all 11 slots filled. Computed live each round and never written into a character. The balance pass sets the numbers.
_pet: Tier C (spec #34 / #119): the pet in the round simulation (PetSystem). pickup_radius: the base pet (Item Pouch and Meso Magnet included) collects every drop kind this close (px) to its centre, center_up above its feet; binocular_mult scales it with Binocular. follow_gap / follow_speed_mult: how it follows the player on the footholds with the player's own physics. teleport_distance, or lost_distance for lost_seconds: it teleports to the player. leash / fetch_dy: Wing Boots fetch resting drops within this far (sideways / vertically) of the player at fetch_speed_mult, walking to within fetch_gap, giving up after fetch_give_up s and pausing fetch_pause s. potion_delay: seconds between the pet's drinks of one kind (Auto HP/MP Potion Pouch, below the ALERT level). jump_*/down_*/stuck_seconds: when the follow controller presses jump.

items._tier: Tier C: survivor-only item with a placeholder price; id 9990000 is reserved for it.
items.name: VAC
items.desc: Your pet pulls every drop on the map to itself. While a pet with VAC is out, the Magnet card is no longer offered.
